In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +38.9 and R +21.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Kenneth Casner runs furthest behind in Johnson, Big Horn, Washakie. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: Voters who find daily costs hard to afford, 56% of voters, 38 to 56, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.79 points; Women, 51% of voters, 35 to 58, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.54 points; Midsize counties, 28% of voters, 36 to 58, where a 5 point gain is worth 1.41 points.
